name: SCTG Mail
description: One safe send_email tool backed by the gog CLI: send-only, allow-listed sender accounts, capped recipients.

gogBinary.description: Path to the gog CLI. Defaults to "gog" (resolved from PATH).

defaultAccount.description: Sender account used when send_email is called without `account`. Required unless every call passes an account.

allowedAccounts.description: Sender accounts the tool may use. Defaults to just defaultAccount. Calls naming another account are refused.

maxRecipients.description: Maximum total recipients (to+cc+bcc) per call. Defaults to 20.

requireApproval.description: Ask the operator to approve every send. Defaults to false so scheduled automations can send unattended.
